pre_condition: source is a string used for error provenance. value is expected to be a dict containing callee specification fields, but may be of any type including None.
post_condition: When value is a dict, returns a CalleeTarget whose fqn is a required non-empty string from the dict and whose info_names is a tuple of string names from the dict (defaulting to an empty tuple when the corresponding field is absent or empty). When value is not a dict, raises ValueError with a message that includes source.
